svg.text: Sus: conectoarele din masina. Jos: modulul si remote starter-ul. Fiecare fir pleaca din pinul lui; cifra de pe bara = numarul de pini al conectorului.
Firele cu cerc gol nu sint conectate: nu se stie inca la ce pin din masina merg.
folosit de lib-ul de PGM, sarit deocamdata in acest firmware
H1/8 Relay COM Brake Activation Output: YELLOW
H1/11 Relay COM Clutch Activation Output: YELLOW/RED
H1/12 Relay N.O. Clutch Activation Output: BROWN/RED
H2/3 (-) Door Output: GREEN/WHITE -> (-) Door Status Input
H2/4 (-) Trunk Output: RED/BLACK -> (-) Trunk Status Input
H2/5 (AC) Tach Output: VIOLET/WHITE -> (AC) Tach Input
H2/6 (+) Ignition Output: GRAY -> (+) Ignition Input/Output
H2/8 (MUX) Brake Output: VIOLET/GREEN -> (+) Brake Status Input
H2/9 (MUX) Brake Output: VIOLET/BROWN -> (+) Brake Status Input
H2/10 E-Brake Output: YELLOW/BLACK -> (-) Neutral Safety/Handbrake Status Input
pin 21: (-) Key Lock (Lock Output + Unlock Output prin R = 200-250 ohm)

Albastru = catre conectoarele din masina. Verde = catre remote starter, cu borna lui alaturi. Mov = de la remote starter direct in masina, fara sa treaca prin modul. Cercurile goale = pini ramasi neconectati.
Linia intrerupta = fir necesar doar in instalare W2W; in D2D informatia trece pe magistrala si firul nu se leaga.
